lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with the highest concentration of distinct centroids located between the lateral ridge and the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the anterior-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal feature along the upper third of the visible flank exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the dorsal edge and deep shadow values immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated low-luminance silhouettes (likely remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral midline and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
